name: gogh-punks-website
description: Official public website for the Gogh Punks collection

scripts.check: npm run site:check && npm run contracts:check
scripts.contracts:check: forge fmt --check && npm run contracts:build && forge lint --severity high && forge test --offline --fuzz-runs 1024 && node scripts/abi-check.mjs
scripts.site:check: node scripts/site-check.mjs && npm run code:check && npm run broker:check && npm test
